rules.description: Employees under a continuous contract get rest days, holiday pay, paid annual leave, sickness allowance, severance and long service payment
At least one rest day in every period of 7 days
Probation is by contract; commonly 1-3 months
Paid annual leave from 7 days (after 12 months) rising to 14 days with service
No statutory overtime rate in Hong Kong; overtime pay follows the employment contract

noticePeriods.description: First month of probation: no notice needed
Rest of probation: at least 7 days (or as agreed)
After probation: as agreed in the contract, at least 7 days; 1 month is common
